architecture_gray_areas.title: Recoverable non-atomic worktree switch
architecture_gray_areas.recommended_option: durable external intent + fresh observation + conditional rollback + recovery-required
alternatives: disable automatic switching and require manual operation

architecture_gray_areas.title: Evidence schemas, single writers and OID self-reference avoidance
architecture_gray_areas.recommended_option: shared envelope + typed append-only payloads + single-writer aggregate + later publication binding

architecture_gray_areas.title: Integration create-only CAS and out-of-CR manual synchronization
architecture_gray_areas.recommended_option: project-scoped lease + exact ordinary ref update + fresh postcheck + explicit sync direction

architecture_gray_areas.title: Control/project worktree and portable ownership isolation
architecture_gray_areas.recommended_option: existing control checkout + configurable sibling project worktree + portable registry + owned-path hard gate
alternatives: bare control repository in a future CR

user_interaction.instruction: Form real architecture trade-offs as decision items; only stop for blockers without a safe option.
